summary: The discovery call on 2026-08-18 included Aditya Reddy (VP Engineering) and Rahul (AE). Aditya highlighted frequent reconciliation failures, RBI inspection pressure, and a CEO mandate to fix the issue before the December audit. He mentioned Stratify as a cheaper competitor and noted that the CFO and CISO must approve any vendor. Rahul proposed bringing the CFO into the conversation within two weeks and promised to provide pricing numbers, moving the deal forward while price concerns remain unresolved.

objections.text: Stratify is cheaper; we are price‑disciplined.
objections.how_handled: Rahul suggested bringing CFO and numbers to address price concerns.

competitors.name: Stratify
competitors.context: Aditya mentioned Stratify reached out and is cheaper.

commitments.what: Schedule meeting with Priya Menon and provide pricing numbers

next_steps: Schedule meeting with Priya Menon within two weeks
buying_signals: High transaction volume (40 lakh UPI per day)
